questions.q: Revenues in order: 10, 20, 60. What is the 3-row moving average at the third row (frame: 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)?
Scenario: your 7-day average uses `ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW`. What is wrong?
why: Correct: 7 before + current = 8 rows. Use 6 PRECEDING.

questions.q: Scenario: day 2024-01-03 is missing in your table. You use LAG to compute the day-over-day change. What happens on 2024-01-04?
options: It compares with 2024-01-02, not with the previous day
why: Correct: LAG uses the previous row.
